rule.precedence: SCORE-SIGN-BUG-CONFIRMED -> AUDIT-INCONCLUSIVE -> SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT (paper ambiguity reported as a secondary finding, SCORE-CORRECT-PAPER-AMBIGUOUS only if score correctness cannot be the primary label)
rule.SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT: production matches the independent oracle for the minimisation objective: every fixed counterexample, cross-parent trap, metamorphic invariant, deferred-sigma test and every captured production pruning decision / cumulative update / routing-statistics propagation / final selection agrees (ties within tolerance excepted and reported)
rule.SCORE-SIGN-BUG-CONFIRMED: at least one reproducible production example where the implemented score or ranking differs from the canonical objective because of a sign, log-probability, normalisation or sorting error
rule.SCORE-CORRECT-PAPER-AMBIGUOUS: implementation matches its documented convention but fidelity to the authors' intent cannot be established; secondary when SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT applies
rule.AUDIT-INCONCLUSIVE: the executed path cannot be traced/captured, or the tests cannot distinguish the deliberately wrong variants (wrong-sign NLL, maximisation, per-parent top-w, reversed sigma, wrong-parent sigma) from the correct one

pilot_validity: B=16 pilot generation remains valid under the documented interpretation
